www.thelasombra.com/NAC2011/qualifiedplayers2011.htm

The last update was July 6th, not June 6th.

I would welcome a new sticky thread, at the top of this forum perhaps, maintained by the national coordinators that keeps up with the regional qualifiers and the national championship events that provide qualifying spots.

I don't believe that there is any value in adding the 10-player tournament winners to that list, as there is already a separate list for that, here:

www.thelasombra.com/decks/twd.htm

Continental Championship organizers can look at the two pages, and can ask the players as they register where and when they qualified.
